problem.concept: Traditional grammar-driven approaches constrain language designers to specific kinds of grammars

evidence.evidence: Model-based language specification decouples language design from language processing and, unlike traditional grammar-driven approaches, which constrain language designers to specific kinds of grammars, it needs general parser generators able to deal with ambiguities.
